semantics.normalized_controls: Artist-facing suggestions are dimensionless, NOT measured morph deltas. Only status=implemented and a nonnull target may be compiled for Blender.
semantics.teacher_policy: No model-internal generator variables available; image references may propose deltas, not certify geometry.
semantics.camera_policy: All 3 source views must be fully framed, margin validated against actual projected bbox.
semantics.provenance_policy: Source SHA must match baseline; no undocumented edits.
semantics.approval_policy: No photo-realism, originality or release approval from schema validation alone.
semantics.geometry_tuning: Three supported head surface shape-key deltas are empirical bounded spatial edits, NOT human likeness/female appearance scores; source BLEND frozen, compare same-camera Cycles against unmodified reference.
